hints.text: This clue's indicator is 'half-baked' and it's an anagram indicator. If something is half-baked it's unformed or foolish, both of which (in cryptic crosswords) can suggest that a word is generally not as it should be, and can be anagrammed. We'll get our answer by anagramming some nearby fodder.
This clue's fodder is 'Splatter'. We'll use these letters to construct our answer, as guided by the indicator(s).
Our definition here is 'waffles', and our answer will be another word for that.
This clue's alternate is: Messily splatter waffles (8)
